source_title: 河洛理數（上海文明書局印行本）卷一·論六爻與十吉體小注
transcription_policy: Selected literal clauses only; editorial punctuation and conventional character variants; counterpart 二五/五二 order retained. No outcome-based branch selection.

position_order.text: 惟五位爲佳。二則次之。三四又次之。初上又次之。

ruler_minister.note: 如得二五君臣之位是也
ruler_minister.counterpart_note: 如得五二君臣之位是也
ruler_minister.scope: The two printings reverse the order of 二五/五二; both name the same two positions. Not a complete favorable/unfavorable line verdict.

zhongzong.note: 如五陽一陰元堂坐一陰爻，五陰一陽元堂坐一陽爻謂之衆宗，觀姤剝復可見。
zhongzong.punctuation: Editorial; 觀 is read as the verb introducing 姤/剝/復, not a fourth hexagram illustration.

dangwei.note: 如陰月生人元堂在陰爻是也
dangwei.scope: 陰月 definition unresolved; no substitution of line-index parity or solstice half-year.

support.note: 元堂坐陰爻位應爻在陽爻是也
support.counterpart_note: 元堂坐陰位應爻在陽爻是也
support.scope: Named primary yin-line/yang-corresponding clause only; not a general response-polarity or full ten-condition verdict. The counterpart omits 爻 after 陰; its wording is retained rather than silently harmonized.

scope: Position preference, two/five seat, five-plus-one Zhongzong and the named primary yin-line/yang-corresponding support clause. Full Dangwei, all support terminology, ten-condition synthesis and outcomes are not certified.
